name: io.github.justinstimatze/linear-strict
title: linear-strict
description: Unofficial Linear MCP server: whole ticket reads, the description as state, rules enforced

environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Linear personal API key, or an agent (app) OAuth token starting lin_oauth_

environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_STRICT_SIGN_OFF
environmentVariables.description: Who approves dropping an unticked Done when item: person (default) or judge

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The judge's API key when LINEAR_STRICT_SIGN_OFF=judge, unless saved with `linear-strict auth judge-key set`
